description: The Drouin marriage register entry attached to Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD) as SD-DRIS-B, and this corpus's unambiguous indexing error — the source `index_error_source` names and the detach guard protects. It indexes the marriage as 9 June 1845 against the profile's 9 June 1849: same day, same month, same bride (Margaret Hayes), same parish (St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke), one digit out in the year. A marriage register entry states its date, so four years is not the estimated-age variance a census age carries; it is a transcription error. The collection is 'database with images', so the remedy here IS a re-read of the original page — unlike the Hole corpus's index-only death index, where no image exists. Detaching would discard a record that is plainly this marriage over one bad field.
